en:
There is an inscription here.{w}{p}Mysterious numbers are carved into its surface.{w}{p}{0E}                                  *  714631.825  *

    61045023  >{0F}{w}
note: Number puzzle: digits, "." and ">" kept exactly, converted to ASCII; line 1 centred, line 2 indented a little like the source.

en: * Dukes' Territory *
note: New area name: dyukusu teritori = "Dukes' Territory" (the zone of the archdukes, daimakou, whose bosses follow). Plural possessive because of the -su ending.

en:
{0E}
                        This Lovable, Unclean World{0F}{w}
note: Title card: full-width centring replaced by leading ASCII spaces (measured with text_build.text_width), leading blank line kept as in chap slice_002; a fresh banner, not an echo of the previous row. aisubeki fujou naru sekai.

en: You heard a high-pitched laugh.{w}{p}A figure slowly took shape in the empty air...{w}and suddenly a stench stung your noses.{w}{p}Poison? All at once, you found it hard to breathe.{w}
note: takawarai = loud, haughty laughter.

en:
The back of your throat turned raw and scratchy,
and breathing grew difficult.{w}What could have come over you so suddenly?{w}
Fighting the discomfort, you looked toward the source of the smell{w}and saw a man, contentedly bathing in hot water.{w}Hot water? That must be what was causing the stench.{w}
note: Boss = Castromandy (MON_TEXT 309: bathes in human excrement). The text only hints, so kept the hint ("hot water? ... the stench"); final period added (source has none).

en: Lover of Filth
note: fujou wo aisuru mono (name box). Lover of Filth, 14 chars.

en: "Come on, come a little closer.{w}It's all right, I won't do anything. Okay?{w}By the way, are there any women among you?"{w}

{0E}
     Where the Candelabra Shines, a Gentleman Stands{0F}{w}
note: Title card: full-width centring replaced by leading ASCII spaces (measured with text_build.text_width), leading blank line kept as in chap slice_002; a fresh banner, not an echo of the previous row.

en:
Flames... one, two, three.{w}The moment the three flames flickered,
a gentleman emerged from the depths of a cloak.{w}{p}His head, however, was a candelabra.{w}
note: "His" from the source's shinshi (gentleman). Final period added.

en:
"Welcome! I am Menolist!"{w}{p}"Ah, but what a cruel turn of events!{w}My long-awaited guests, and they turn out to be you!"{w}{p}"I'm afraid I must ask you to die!{w}My apologies for dragging you
into this little hobby of mine."{w}{p}"At the very least, allow me to kill you swiftly!"{w}
note: New name: Menolist (MONSTER3 / MON_TEXT 310: a gentleman archduke who wants duels, except against people of the new lands -- hence his disappointment). sekkaku no kyakujin = guests he had looked forward to.

en:
{0E}
          Built XXXX, Reinforced-Adductor Clamshell{0F}{w}
note: Real-estate listing parody: chiku XXXX-nen (built in year XXXX) + kaigara heikakukin kenchiku, a pun on tekkin (reinforced concrete) construction with heikakukin = adductor muscle. Rendered "Built XXXX, Reinforced-Adductor Clamshell" to keep the pun; x-marks turned into XXXX. Title card: full-width centring replaced by leading ASCII spaces (measured with text_build.text_width), leading blank line kept as in chap slice_002; a fresh banner, not an echo of the previous row.

en:
A clam was walking along.{w}When its shell opened, a huge eyeball looked out of the gap.{w}It glared at you.{w}{p}Its gaze was overwhelming, arrogant.{w}You felt as though you were being appraised
down to your guts, right into your pores.{w}
note: Final period added after "glared at you" (source has none before {w}{p}).

en: Fanisakil
note: New name: Fanisakil (fanisakiru; MON_TEXT 305: a parasite archduke currently living in a bivalve).

en: "Hmm? Well, I suppose you'll do.{w}Oh, and take all that weird junk off.{w}It's in the way."{w}
note: mazu konna tokoro ka = sizing the party up ("you'll do"). sono hen na mono = their equipment, presumably; kept vague as "weird junk". Fanisakil is a parasite, so the demand is sinister; gender unknown, no pronouns used.

en:
{0E}
                                 !Ponyapo-nyapo!{0F}{w}
note: Source banner is the nonsense chant "!ponyaa-poonyapo!". Title card: full-width centring replaced by leading ASCII spaces (measured with text_build.text_width), leading blank line kept as in chap slice_002; a fresh banner, not an echo of the previous row.

en: Something delicious-looking was dancing.{w}
Ponyapo
note: New name: Ponyapo (ponyaapo). Joke monster; MON_TEXT 311 describes it with the same deadpan.

Gibberish speech. "ponyaapo ni yoru ponyaapo no tame no ponyaapo" parodies "of the people, by the people, for the people" -> "Ponyapo of Ponyapo, by Ponyapo, for Ponyapo". Source fills each page with exactly 3 lines, so explicit \n kept to give the same wall-of-text look; the "!" page keeps its single "?" in the middle of line 2. The "!" lines are padded to about 330 px ("!" is 3 px wide) to mirror the full-width wall; all explicit lines checked < 376 px.

en:
{0E}
                             The Prodigy's Canvas{0F}{w}
note: kisai = eccentric genius. Title card: full-width centring replaced by leading ASCII spaces (measured with text_build.text_width), leading blank line kept as in chap slice_002; a fresh banner, not an echo of the previous row.

en: A man was painting in silence.{w}One stroke made the sky, one stroke made the earth,{w}and in no time at all the picture was complete.{w}{p}Looking closer, you saw that it couldn't be held by the canvas;{w}his painting had splattered everywhere around it.{w}
Giant Painter
note: kyodai na gaka. MON_TEXT 306: court painter of the giants (Allied Painter in the bestiary).

en:
"Just when I thought I'd run out of the color of life,
here you come right on cue. Such is my genius!{w}Hey, paint's not supposed to run away, got it?"{w}
note: Source lacks the closing quote bracket; added it in English. wagahai = pompous "I". The party is his "paint" (seimei no iro = color of life, i.e. their blood).

en:
{0E}
                                 Garden of Flesh{0F}{w}
note: nikukai kaen. Title card: full-width centring replaced by leading ASCII spaces (measured with text_build.text_width), leading blank line kept as in chap slice_002; a fresh banner, not an echo of the previous row.

en: A writhing mass of flesh.{w}{p}Yet its surface was as smooth as a baby's,{w}and the contrast was almost revolting.{w}{p}Its mouth was tiny for all that flesh;{w}it was saying something, but the thick flesh swallowed the sound and you could barely make any of it out.{w}
note: First sentence kept as a verbless fragment, like the source.

en: Lump of Flesh
note: nikukai (name box).

en: "...is what you'd think, right?{w}You feeble little things.{w}See, with a single swing like this..."{w}
note: Starts mid-sentence on purpose: the previous row says its words are swallowed by the flesh, so you only catch the end. Trailing-off ending kept.

en:
{0E}
                Multi-Dimensional Stacked Residence{0F}{w}
note: tajigen-sou-shiki juukyo: real-estate style label. Title card: full-width centring replaced by leading ASCII spaces (measured with text_build.text_width), leading blank line kept as in chap slice_002; a fresh banner, not an echo of the previous row.

en: Burrow Peeker
note: suana kara kao wo dasu mono = "one who pokes its face out of the burrow"; shortened for the name box (13 chars).

en: "Whoa there! No peeking inside!{w}What else do you think is going to come out?{w}Some candy? Some flowers?"{w}{p}"Or maybe... monsters?"{w}

{0E}
                    Smells good... Is it stew tonight?{0F}{w}
note: Title card: full-width centring replaced by leading ASCII spaces (measured with text_build.text_width), leading blank line kept as in chap slice_002; a fresh banner, not an echo of the previous row.

en: A lump of metal was floating before your eyes.{w}There was a slit in it.{w}{p}Peering through the slit, you saw a room with a fireplace, and an old couple relaxing inside.{w}{p}Puffing on his pipe, the old man spoke.{w}
note: "his" from roujin/rou-fuufu (old man of an old married couple; next speaker is roubaa, old woman).

en: Old Man
"Welcome, from so very far away.{w}You must be weary. Do come in, please."{w}
"There's still some of the pie I baked this morning.{w}Do you like meat pie?{w}I'll warm it up for you right now."{w}
note: Speaker roubaa (Old Woman; its name row is translated elsewhere).

en:
{0E}
                               Smog the Legdars{0F}{w}
note: sumoggu za reggudaasu. The bestiary spells the boss rekkudaasu (MON_TEXT 300), the banner reggudaasu; romanized the banner as written: "Legdars". New name -- unify with the monster table if it becomes "Reckdars".
hasseigen = "the source" (of the fog), kept as the narration's label for the creature. shinri (psychology) read as "that thought". niyari to warau given the subject "it".

en:
{0E}
                  Within the Womb of the Demon Milk{0F}{w}
note: mamyuu no tainai. mamyuu is the epithet of the boss (MONSTER3: mamyuu Sarebos, a wet-nurse archduke); "Demon Milk" literal. Title card: full-width centring replaced by leading ASCII spaces (measured with text_build.text_width), leading blank line kept as in chap slice_002; a fresh banner, not an echo of the previous row.

en:
You heard a voice.{w}A groan? A scream? A moan?{w}{p}Your eyes darted toward the voice,{w}and there you saw a giant pregnant woman.{w}{p}It seemed that whatever she said,{w}it all came out sounding like that.{w}You couldn't tell what she was trying to say.{w}{p}But in her glittering eyes
you saw no friendly light.{w}
note: "she" from the source (ninpu, kanojo).

en:
{0E}
                   Sing! Sing of This Sorrow and Joy!{0F}{w}
note: utae! kono nageki to yorokobi wo! Title card: full-width centring replaced by leading ASCII spaces (measured with text_build.text_width), leading blank line kept as in chap slice_002; a fresh banner, not an echo of the previous row.

en: You heard singing.{w}The singer was drawing steadily closer.{w}{p}You couldn't even tell what language it was in,{w}yet you could recognize it as a 'song.'{w}For whom was he singing?{w}{p}The song grew louder still,{w}and you were swallowed up by it.{w}
note: "he" from the source (kare). The single-quoted 'song' mirrors the source's quote brackets.

en:
{0E}
           The Hour the Shining Twin Serpents Dance{0F}{w}
note: hikaru sooja ga odoru toki. Title card: full-width centring replaced by leading ASCII spaces (measured with text_build.text_width), leading blank line kept as in chap slice_002; a fresh banner, not an echo of the previous row.

en: There were two great serpents.{w}The pair were entwined as if dancing,{w}so that they even looked like a single pillar.{w}{p}The two did not speak.{w}But the sound of their dancing, rubbing bodies{w}told you one simple fact.{w}{p}You are 'food.'{w}
note: Last line kept in present tense ("You are 'food.'") as the fact the serpents convey.

en:
{0E}
                                  Trapania Mighty{0F}{w}
note: torapania maitii, romanized. Boss is apparently Taizalti (MON_TEXT 312). Title card: full-width centring replaced by leading ASCII spaces (measured with text_build.text_width), leading blank line kept as in chap slice_002; a fresh banner, not an echo of the previous row.

en: How should one even describe him?{w}By any measure, a mollusk.{w}And yet you sensed a tremendous charisma.{w}{p}Clattering the countless arrows that ran through his head as if they were fangs,{w}he spoke to you like a friend of ten-odd years.{w}
note: Source says yumi (bows) piercing the head; rendered "arrows" because the bestiary (MON_TEXT 312) says the things in its head are arrows (ya) from a fight with Polyte, and bows cannot pierce a head. "him/he" from the source (kare).

en: ?Mollusk?
note: Name box ?nantai doubutsu? kept with its question marks.

en: "To think you made it thith far...{w}...Forgive me, talking ith a little hard for me."{w}{p}"Talented people are treathureth,{w}and I theek them out, whatever their rathe.{w}Treating them with contempt ith thimply foolish."{w}{p}"Now then, let'th have a little practical exam.{w}Don't dithappoint me, will you?"{w}
note: Speech impediment: source garbles sentence endings (da -> fa, masu -> fu, yo -> hyo) because of the arrows through his head, and says talking is hard. Rendered as a consistent s -> th lisp so it stays readable; adjust if a different style is preferred.

en:
{0E}
                             The Old Blade's Reach{0F}{w}
note: rouha no maai: maai = striking distance. Title card: full-width centring replaced by leading ASCII spaces (measured with text_build.text_width), leading blank line kept as in chap slice_002; a fresh banner, not an echo of the previous row.
15 "!" as in the source.

en: Ebirahan
note: New name: Ebirahan (MON_TEXT 314: his jaw drops with a "Vaa!" before he slaughters).

en: "VAAAH!!!"{w}
note: vaa! = the jaw-drop cry from the bestiary. Caps for the roar.
Floor warning; highlighted first sentence kept inside {0E}..{0F}; "presence of darkness" as in wmap slice_02 row 119. Trailing space before {w} kept as in the source.

en:
When you reached the Sanctum of Genesis,
Zaalhaut was waiting for you, looking impatient.{w}
note: New term: seisouken = "Sanctum of Genesis" (sei holy + sou creation + ken sphere; 18 chars, fits the DGN_NAME dungeon-name max of 18).

en: "Just how long do you intend to keep ME waiting!?"{w}
note: kono washi wo = "me, of all people" -> stressed ME.

en:
"Listen well. There is something
I need you to obtain."{w}{p}"Defeat every one of the Qualia that guard
this Sanctum of Genesis, and claim their ranks."{w}{p}"Bear those ranks into the Coronation Hall,
and you can gain the Sun's Light Rank."{w}{p}"With the Sun's Light Rank,
Rafa can be made a true Sun Spirit."{w}{p}"Come on, let's get moving.
We can't stay here for long, you know."{w}
note: New terms: kuoria = "Qualia" (Red/Blue/... Qualia in EL_KIRO/MONSTER3; used as a count noun, same form singular and plural); kurai = "rank"; taikan no ma = "Coronation Hall"; taiyou no koui = "the Sun's Radiant Rank"; taiyousei = Sun Spirit (existing). Last page identical to row 1644 on purpose.

en:
"Come on, let's get moving.
We can't stay here for long, you know."{w}
note: Same source text as the last page of row 1643; English kept identical.

en:
"This is the Sanctum of Genesis, ruled by the Light of All Knowledge.{w}Beings such as you
will not be permitted to go one step further."{w}{p}"Let me say this at the outset:
there is no room whatsoever for discussion.{w}You will be eliminated without delay."{w}{p}"Entering this place,
having come this far at all --
that alone warrants elimination."{w}{p}"Commencing elimination.{w}Be burned by the holy light, and vanish."{w}
note: No speaker name (6 reuses; likely the Qualia guardians). New term: banchi no hikari = "the Light of All Knowledge". Cold, formal register.

en: * The light enveloped you *{0F}{w}
note: Stray {0F} with no {0E} kept as in the source. Source typo (tsutsumikomikonda) ignored.

en:
{0E}
                                  Within the Light{0F}{w}
note: hikari no naka. Title card: full-width centring replaced by leading ASCII spaces (measured with text_build.text_width), leading blank line kept as in chap slice_002; a fresh banner, not an echo of the previous row.

en:
The light from the upper level has grown stronger.{w}With Zaalhaut gone,
it would be dangerous for you to go on alone.{w}
note: jousou = upper level (DGN_NAME: Sanctum upper/middle/lower floors).

en: "That will be quite enough mischief, if you please."{w}
note: Speaker ??? (an Opinion Bit, revealed in row 1652).

en: Turning toward the voice, you saw strange beings clad in light.{w}

"This is the Sanctum of Genesis, ruled by the Light of All Knowledge.{w}It is no place for those like yourselves,
whose soles are soiled with mud."{w}
note: First sentence worded exactly as row 1645 (same Japanese).

en: "So you've shown up again...{w}Opinion Bit...!"{w}
Opinion Bit

"...Oh? How very odd.{w}You came to the Sanctum of Genesis last time as well, did you not?"{w}{p}"Why would you try to throw away
the life you were lucky enough to keep?"{w}
note: Addressed to Zaalhaut (anata written with the female kanji in the source; English "you" needs no gender). hirotta inochi = a life narrowly saved.

en: "Heh heh. I left a little something behind, you see."{w}
"I see. So this time you mean to use these people as a shield to reach the Coronation Hall."{w}
note: sono monodomo = slightly disdainful "those ones"; kept neutral as "these people".

en:
"No, you're wrong, Opinion Bit.{w}I'm the one who'll be dealing with you lot.
They're the ones heading to the Coronation Hall."{w}
note: omaetachi = the Opinion Bits (plural, there are several) -> "you lot".

en:
"Allow me to confirm: you were nearly killed
by us once before, were you not?"{w}
"Aye, that's right. What of it?"{w}
note: "sono toori da ga" -- trailing "ga" (but...) rendered as "What of it?".

en: "Please wait a moment."{w}

note: Parallel narration in slice_021 row 1668 ("again..."); keep the wording aligned there.

en:
"..........{w}...We have reached the conclusion that this cannot be understood."{w}{p}"We will set this topic aside.{w}Now, let us proceed with your elimination.
And after that, everyone behind you."{w}
note: gidai wo kaihi shimasu = "We will set this topic aside" -- recurs in slice_021 rows 1669 and 1676; keep the same wording. Speaking to Zaalhaut; "sono ushiro no minasama" = the party.

en: Magic power enough to make you freeze in your tracks began to gather around the Opinion Bits.{w}
"Opinion Bit."{w}
note: Vocative "Opinion Bit yo" -- a calm call for attention before the riddle.

en: "Yes? What is it?"{w}
"The longer it grows, the closer it gets to the ground...{w}Do you know what it is?"{w}
note: Riddle; answer "Hair" comes in slice_021 row 1670. Worded so "hair" works as the answer.

en: The Opinion Bits stopped moving.{w}
